clue.text: Professional dream, a learner becoming qualified

parts.note: pro is the short form of professional
a dream is a vision
L is the learner driver's plate letter

explanation.surface: A career-minded dreamer earns a qualification after learning the ropes.
explanation.definitionFit: A provisional arrangement is qualified, holding only under conditions rather than absolutely.

clue.text: Flower I have found in middle of burrow

indicators.note: found in says the contraction sits within the other letters
middle of takes the central letters of burrow

parts.note: I've is the contraction of I have

explanation.surface: A bloom discovered deep inside an animal's burrow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower' is crossword code for something that flows; the middle of BURROW is RR.
explanation.definitionFit: In crosswords a flower is something that flows, so a river.

clue.text: Spent time in place, struggled to get around it

indicators.note: to get around says the first word encloses the other

parts.note: vied means competed or struggled
to sit something somewhere is to place it

explanation.surface: Someone stayed put somewhere while battling to get round it.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'it' is a link word pointing back to place; 'to get around' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: To have visited a place is to have spent time in it.

clue.text: Holy bag the colour of blood

parts.note: a sac is a bag-like part in an animal or plant
blood is red

explanation.surface: A sacred bag dyed blood red.
explanation.definitionFit: Sacred and holy are synonyms for consecrated or revered.

clue.text: Artist arrived in front of audience, being filmed

parts.note: a performer who is on is in front of the audience
came means arrived
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: An artist turns up in front of spectators while the cameras roll.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone on camera is being recorded or filmed.

clue.text: Sailor away from other crew members finds gastropod

parts.note: AB is an able seaman
someone away from the others is alone

explanation.surface: A lone sailor discovers a sea snail.
explanation.definitionFit: The abalone is an edible sea snail, a kind of gastropod mollusc.

clue.text: Shedding pounds to improve one's mood?

definitions.text: Shedding pounds to improve one's mood?

parts.words: Shedding pounds to improve one's mood?
parts.note: seems to be dieting to lose weight, but pounds are money spent in shops to cheer oneself up

explanation.surface: Losing weight to feel happier.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means shopping as a way of lifting one's spirits, spending money for comfort.

clue.text: More miserable friend, one having a go

parts.note: a pal is a friend
a trier is someone who has a go

explanation.surface: A gloomier friend who at least keeps trying.
explanation.definitionFit: Paltrier means meaner or more wretched, comparative of paltry.

clue.text: A new lady involved with eight acting as pioneers

indicators.note: involved suggests letters tangled up together into a new order

explanation.surface: A newcomer becomes caught up with a rowing eight blazing a trail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved' shuffles A NEW LADY together with EIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: Pioneers are out in front, which is the idiom for showing others the route.

clue.text: Singer is almost impish

indicators.note: almost tells us to stop the word one letter short of its end

parts.note: elvish means mischievous like an elf, so impish

explanation.surface: A singer described as being mostly mischievous.
explanation.definitionFit: Elvis Presley is the famous rock and roll singer known by his first name.

clue.text: Salt a runner used in run?

indicators.note: used in says these pieces are placed inside the other word

parts.note: a run of performances or events is a cycle
a runner is a long narrow mat or carpet

explanation.surface: A question about whether salt was spread on a running track.
explanation.walkthrough: 'runner' suggests an athlete but means a long strip of carpet; 'used in' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Sodium cyclamate is a chemical salt once widely used as an artificial sweetener.

clue.text: Wind creates a stir, blowing around lots of paper

indicators.note: letters blowing around are scattered into a new order

parts.note: a ream is a large quantity of paper, 500 sheets

explanation.surface: A gust stirs things up and sends a stack of paper flying.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blowing around' signals the anagram; 'creates' is only a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: An airstream is a current of air, which is a wind.

clue.text: Group of eight a bit behind the commanding officer

indicators.note: behind places the small amount after the officer's letters

parts.note: OC stands for Officer Commanding
a tad is a small amount

explanation.surface: A small part of a group trailing behind its army commander.
explanation.definitionFit: Octad is a technical word for a set or group of eight things.

clue.text: Innocent youngster with old-fashioned haircut, a Greek character

parts.note: a lamb is a young sheep and a byword for innocence
a DA, or duck's arse, is a 1950s slicked-back hairstyle

explanation.surface: A naive young person with a retro hairstyle turns out to be Greek.
explanation.definitionFit: Lambda is the eleventh letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Fellow trapping rodent, house task taking time

indicators.note: trapping means the first word holds the others inside it

parts.note: a fellow is a man
a rat is a rodent

explanation.surface: A man catching a rat around the house finds it a lengthy job.
explanation.definitionFit: A marathon is figuratively any long, gruelling task that takes ages.

clue.text: Following Descartes, first to go off as well

indicators.note: first to go off tells us the opening letter is removed

parts.note: a follower of the philosopher Descartes is a Cartesian

explanation.surface: A philosophical disciple of Descartes who also loses his leading position.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as well' reads as 'also' but defines a kind of well: an artesian well, where water rises under its own pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: Artesian describes a well bored so that water is forced upward by natural pressure.

clue.text: Fool greeting monarch — man among the duds?

parts.note: a clot is a fool
hi is a greeting
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the queen

explanation.surface: An idiot says hello to the king, a dud among men.
explanation.walkthrough: 'duds' looks like failures but is slang for clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: A clothier makes or sells garments, so works amid clothes, slang duds.

clue.text: No-nonsense tactics, an element of cricket

definitions.meaning: playing ... means using tough, uncompromising methods
cricket is played with a hard leather ball, unlike softball games

explanation.surface: A tough approach likened to part of the game of cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means ruthless tactics, and literally names the hard ball used in cricket.

clue.text: Poem able to stir boy within

indicators.note: within puts the boy inside the rearranged letters
to stir is to mix up, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: A poem can stir a boy's feelings within.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stir' signals the anagram and 'within' the container; a ballade is a French verse form.
explanation.definitionFit: A ballade is a French verse form with three stanzas and an envoi.

clue.text: Feel sad about performer finally getting the bird

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of performer

parts.note: an egret is a kind of heron

explanation.surface: Feeling down after a performer is booed off the stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting the bird' is British slang for being booed or hissed, but here it simply adds a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: To regret something is to feel sorrow or remorse about it.

clue.text: Ironing that comes late in the day

definitions.meaning: smoothing out, as one irons out creases

definitions.text: that comes late in the day
definitions.meaning: the period at the end of daytime

explanation.definitionFit: Evening means levelling out, and is also the time after the afternoon.

clue.text: After gym a silly person gets a bit of food

parts.note: PE, physical education, is gym class
a nut is a crazy person

explanation.surface: After gym class a fool tucks into a snack.
explanation.definitionFit: A peanut is a small edible nut, a little piece of food.

clue.text: Beast making speed to lake

parts.note: a rate is a speed
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: An animal hurrying towards the water.
explanation.definitionFit: The ratel is the honey badger, a fierce African and Asian animal.

clue.text: So the Engineers must come to front

parts.note: RE stands for the Royal Engineers
fore means the front part

explanation.surface: An order that the army engineers should advance to the front line.
explanation.definitionFit: So and therefore are synonyms meaning consequently.

clue.text: Ancient cave? Look up at the top of it

indicators.note: at the top of it places the reversed look before the cave in this down entry
in a down clue, up means the word for look is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: lo is an old word for look
a den is an animal's cave or lair

explanation.surface: Gazing upward at the roof of an ancient cave.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' signals reading backwards, and 'at the top of it' puts that piece first.
explanation.definitionFit: Olden is a literary word meaning of former times, old.

clue.text: Trial for stroke-player joining one cricket side

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for
a bat plays strokes, or a batter is a bat in cricket
I is the Roman numeral one
the on side is the leg side of a cricket field

explanation.surface: A trial period for a batter joining a cricket team.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the field is split into the off side and the on (leg) side.
explanation.definitionFit: Probation is a trial period testing someone's suitability or conduct.

clue.text: God dressed like a tranny, all but

indicators.note: all but means take everything except the final letter

parts.note: a cross-dresser is in drag

explanation.surface: A deity wearing women's clothing, or nearly so.
explanation.definitionFit: Indra is the Hindu god of thunder and the heavens.

clue.text: Spy's target seen moving round about

indicators.note: round places the scrambled letters around the abbreviation
moving means the letters are rearranged

parts.note: c, from circa, means about

explanation.surface: A spy's target has been spotted on the move.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' scrambles TARGET SEEN into SERETAGENT, and 'round' wraps that around C.
explanation.definitionFit: A secret agent is a spy working undercover for a government.
